column4: Show names, results and bulgarian commanders of the battles with no ships lost in the 'English Channel'.
column5: SELECT name ,  RESULT ,  bulgarian_commander FROM battle EXCEPT SELECT T1.name ,  T1.result ,  T1.bulgarian_commander FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle WHERE T2.location  =  'English Channel'
column6: SELECT T1.name, T1.result, T1.bulgarian_commander FROM battle AS T1 WHERE T1.id NOT IN (SELECT T2.caused_by_ship_id FROM death AS T2 JOIN ship AS T3 ON T2.caused_by_ship_id = T3.id WHERE T3.location LIKE '%English Channel%')

column4: What are the ids and names of the battles that led to more than 10 people killed in total.
column5: SELECT T1.id ,  T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle JOIN death AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING sum(T3.killed)  >  10
column6: SELECT b.id, b.name FROM battle AS b JOIN death AS d ON b.id = d.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY b.id, b.name HAVING SUM(d.killed) > 10

column4: What are the death and injury situations caused by the ship with tonnage 't'?
column5: SELECT T1.killed ,  T1.injured FROM death AS T1 JOIN ship AS t2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id  =  T2.id WHERE T2.tonnage  =  't'
column6: SELECT T1.note AS death_note, T2.note AS injury_note FROM death AS T1 INNER JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id = T2.id WHERE T2.tonnage = 't'

column4: For the cars with 4 cylinders, which model has the largest horsepower?
column5: SELECT T1.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.Cylinders  =  4 ORDER BY T2.horsepower DESC LIMIT 1;
column6: SELECT T2.Model FROM cars_data AS T1 INNER JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.Maker WHERE T1.Cylinders = 4 ORDER BY T1.Horsepower DESC LIMIT 1

column4: Which distinctive models are produced by maker with the full name General Motors or weighing more than 3500?
column5: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Model  =  T2.Model JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T2.Maker  =  T3.Id JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T1.MakeId  =  T4.Id WHERE T3.FullName  =  'General Motors' OR T4.weight  >  3500;
column6: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM car_names AS T1 INNER JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.Make = T2.Id WHERE T2.FullName LIKE 'General Motors' OR T1.Weight > 3500

column4: What is the model for the car with a weight smaller than the average?
column5: SELECT T1.model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.Weight  <  (SELECT avg(Weight) FROM CARS_DATA)
column6: SELECT T2.Model FROM cars_data AS T1 INNER JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.Maker WHERE T1.Weight < (SELECT AVG(Weight) FROM cars_data)

column4: List all song names by singers above the average age.

column6: SELECT T2.song_name FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.singer_id = T2.singer_id GROUP BY T1.name HAVING AVG(T1.age) > (SELECT AVG(age) FROM singer)

column4: List all singer names in concerts in year 2014.
column5: SELECT T2.name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id  =  T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.concert_id  =  T3.concert_id WHERE T3.year  =  2014
column6: SELECT T3.Name FROM singer AS T1 INNER JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID INNER JOIN concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_ID = T3.concert_ID WHERE T3.Year = '2014'

column4: What is the name and country of origin of every singer who has a song with the word 'Hey' in its title?
column5: SELECT name ,  country FROM singer WHERE song_name LIKE '%Hey%'
column6: SELECT T1.Name, T1.Country FROM singer AS T1 INNER JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID INNER JOIN concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_ID = T3.concert_ID WHERE T3.Theme LIKE '%Hey%'

column6: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Template_Type_Description FROM Documents AS T1 INNER JOIN Templates AS T2 ON T1.Template_ID = T2.Template_ID

column4: Show all paragraph ids and texts for the document with name 'Welcome to NY'.

column4: What are the names of high schoolers who both have friends and are liked?

column4: Which department offers the most number of degrees? List department name and id.

column4: What are the African countries that have a  population less than any country in Asia?
column5: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Africa"  AND population  <  (SELECT max(population) FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Asia")
